findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reclassify the sidecar edit as an in-scope code change: add an explicit top-level `evidence_sufficient:false` carry line to the FAIL payload (mirroring the verdict_obtainable line at :374-375), and decide how the per-criterion markers survive given `criteria` is dropped on the FAIL path.
evidence: Plan: 'persists `criteria` as-is — verified pass-through; a round-trip test pins it, no code change expected'
completion_sidecar.py FAIL payload (:355-369) has no `criteria` key; PASS payload (:335) has `criteria`
completion_sidecar.py:374-375: `if v.get("verdict_obtainable") is False: payload["verdict_obtainable"] = False` — markers are added by explicit line, not generic pass-through
findings.finding: The plan states completion_sidecar.py is a 'verified pass-through' persisting `criteria` as-is with 'no code change expected', but the FAIL sidecar payload is an explicit field whitelist that (1) omits `criteria` entirely on FAIL (only the PASS payload at :335 includes it), dropping the per-criterion `evidence_sufficient:false` markers on the very FAIL path insufficient-evidence verdicts take, and (2) carries the top-level `verdict_obtainable` marker only via an explicit `if v.get('verdict_obtainable') is False:` line (:374-375). By that same precedent the top-level `evidence_sufficient:false` marker will NOT round-trip on the FAIL sidecar without an added explicit line.
scenarios: An insufficient-evidence verdict (verdict=FAIL) is persisted to the durable sidecar; the top-level marker is silently dropped, and per-criterion markers are dropped because `criteria` is absent from the FAIL payload
findings.suggested_fix: In completion_sidecar.py add `if v.get("evidence_sufficient") is False: payload["evidence_sufficient"] = False` to the FAIL payload; if per-criterion markers must persist, either include a marker-only `criteria` projection on FAIL or fold the insufficiency into the findings' recorded class. Update the plan's sidecar bullet from 'no code change expected' accordingly.
